Tesla (TSLA) isn't the only EV company struggling with handle design: Xiaomi (1810.HK, XIACF) stocks fall after a tragic fatal accident. And as NVIDIA (NVDA), Oracle (ORCL) and other Big AI stocks recover Friday's losses in pre-market, Applied Digital (APLD) continues to rise, powered by data center deals with CoreWeave (CRWV) and others.
